NVDA.finding: Issuer-linked current results release retrieved. It does not provide a separate recognized income amount for infrastructure-financier equity-method investments; earlier SEC/CFO note gaps are not filled by the aggregate results.

MSFT.finding: Following the actual issuer download links resolved the previously attempted 404 financial-statements route. The Office viewer is only a shell; the issuer XLSX and DOCX were downloaded from their embedded public document URLs and read as data, without executing workbook macros or formulas. Workbook sheet7 reports XBOX 5379 and Search/Advertising 6554 for the current quarter. Neither it nor the metrics/transcript provides a prohibited-activity revenue partition or a current interest-only split. Transcript paragraph discussing roughly negative 300 other income/expense is future guidance and is not a current-period income observation.
MSFT.scenario_scope: Conservative mixed-line arithmetic, not the actual complete non-compliant numerator and not an approval. Either mixed activity bucket exceeds this residual capacity; no within-bucket prohibited amount is established.

GOOGL.finding: Issuer-linked earnings selector retrieved, but its static response contains no new period-specific revenue partition. No current prohibited-income amount was obtained from this page; original SEC evidence remains the numerical basis.

AMZN.finding: Quarterly landing page was revisited. It is not an additional independent company statement and exposes no new required current-period income partition in the retrieved response. Existing filings/releases still aggregate retail, subscriptions and seller activities.

TSLA.finding: Issuer-linked Q3 webcast landing page retrieved. Its static response exposes no written insurance-revenue reconciliation or linked written transcript. The webcast audio was not transcribed; this is not a claim that the spoken call contains no relevant information. The previous update deck, statutory access findings and NAIC timing limitations stand.

META.finding: Quarterly earnings tab retrieved; no new income-allocation table is present in its static response. PDF strings in site scripts include historical filing replacements, not evidence that a current supplement or new lease/income number was obtained.

AVGO.finding: Financial reports page identifies current 10-Q accession 0001730168-26-000080 already reviewed. The landing page does not provide an additional gross-interest split; a copy/download of the same filing is not independent new economic evidence.

supplemental_source_review.source_limit: Static issuer landing pages without a period-specific table do not prove absence of a disclosure in all public sources. No access obstacle was treated as a zero value.
